meta.title: Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Procurement Manager role and as a Procurement Manager on the specified Enterprise tenant
Open and use Vendor Blocking and Inactive Lifecycle to block vendors and reactivate SAP-inactivated vendors
Observe and compare refusal or absence for the non-Procurement-Manager user versus availability for the Procurement Manager
Verify whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants the action to additional roles
